defs.meaning: 浮现，出现；显露，知悉；恢复过来，幸存下来（emerge 的现在分词）

examples.en: Asia's emerging economies will be on a self-sustaining cycle of growth.
examples.zh: 亚洲的新兴经济体会出现自我维持的循环增长。

examples.en: The television screens of the next century will be linked up to an emerging world telecommunications grid.
examples.zh: 下个世纪的电视屏幕将与一种新兴的世界电信网格相连。

examples.en: A new order seems to be emerging.
examples.zh: 新的秩序似乎正在显现。

synonyms.meaning: 形成；浮现；显露（emerge的ing形式）；由…中脱出
